title: Stable isotopes: verdict profile
description: Rule L2 with flat-bands-lead and +D (PLAN v3.2 Step 9; DECISIONS 13, 15, 16, 36). m = CONS3 (median of three collagen models). Model verdict: Unlikely below 0.5, Borderline to 3, Good from 3. Flat bands (evidence 'none') -> Unlikely whatever m reads. +D: both protein bands readable and flat with m >= 3 -> Borderline. Lift, on a scan with no plaster, wax, ester or C1 sign, every one of them checked (none gated by its own B6b gate; C1 assessed), with all six collagen bands readable and lit: strong -> Good, clear -> at least Borderline. Contaminant and burnt signs are FLAGS only and never change the verdict (DECISIONS 53). Models-disagree note: only when the three CONS3 components fall in different verdict bands, i.e. straddle the 0.5 or the 3 cut, AND span at least 1 point (DECISIONS 65). Notes: above_bone_range when m > above_bone_range_m_above (DECISIONS 72); possible_thin_coating when the soft tier fired (it also suppresses the positive-signs line; DECISIONS 76); contaminants_not_checked lists the skipped (gated) and checked signs; c1_reduced (the truncated C1 ran) is details-only. ZooMS line (DECISIONS 80 amended): the ZooMS band-pattern rule (check.zooms_patterns with its 1545 nm vote, unchanged) runs underneath; where it calls the scan better than this verdict (Good > Borderline > Unlikely; Can't tell never counts) a note says so and never changes the verdict: zooms_better_good (ZooMS Good), zooms_better_protein (ZooMS Borderline from the band pattern), zooms_better_1545 (ZooMS Borderline only through the 1545 nm vote; zooms_better_1545_flat when flat bands set the verdict). No line when a sign in suppressed_by_signs fired (wax, ester, plaster, C1: coatings can create the C-H bands the patterns read); burnt, gated or unassessed signs do not suppress it. The band-pattern Borderline splits by strength: zooms_better_protein needs m >= 0.3 and at least two N-type bands (NH2044, AM2175, the 1545 nm vote band) lit and readable, else zooms_faint_protein (a quieter note, shown only when a slot is left: precedence_last). Ryder line: on an Unlikely verdict with no band line, when the published Ryder 2045 model reads >= ryder_2045_at_least, zooms_better_ryder (params r, at_least) is the ZooMS line and a faint protein note stays in the details. Shown after the rule's note and before the supporting note (precedence_zooms). Keys only (the UI holds the strings); at most two shown.

provenance.basis: Phase 0a A19 (rule L2), A20 (display, sort), Matt's rulings DECISIONS 13-16, 36, 41, 45, 52, 53, 65, 80 (amended: one verdict for every analysis plus a ZooMS line). Cuts: the published 3% line (Ryder et al. 2026) and 0.5%.
provenance.zooms_ryder_2045_cut: 0.34% yield: the a priori ZooMS cut of Ryder et al. 2026b (Archaeometry, doi:10.1111/arcm.70202): 0.26 %N converted to collagen yield with the Brock et al. 2010 regression (0.33, rounded up). Not tuned on any test set; phase 0d evaluation: no line on true-zero archaeological bone.

second_opinion.basis: Phase 0b item 18: |S1_R2 - CONS3| on 36 concordant standard/high-res pairs (high-res side), 95th percentile 4.10 (bootstrap CI 2.96-5.92)
